setup: The trapezoid has parallel sides of \([[base_a]]\) and \([[base_b]]\) and a height of \([[height]]\).

steps.say: A trapezoid has one pair of parallel sides, and its area is not simply base times height because the two bases differ: \([[base_a]]\) and \([[base_b]]\).
Taking the average of the two bases makes the trapezoid behave like a rectangle of that width, so the area is the average times the height \([[height]]\), which is \([[area]]\).

answer: So the trapezoid's area is \([[area]]\) square units.
